items.title: Mac Jones will start in Week 13 against the Seahawks.
items.text: Brock Purdy (ankle) has been ruled out, leaving Jones as the 49ers’ starter this week. Jones played very well in multiple starts last season, though he faces a tough Seahawks defense. Jones is a starter in two-quarterback leagues. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: 49ers ruled out Brock Purdy (ankle) for Week 12 against the Seahawks.
items.text: Mac Jones will start in Purdy’s stead. 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said Purdy is dealing with a mid-ankle sprain, and the team is optimistic about his availability for Week 13 against the Giants. Jones piloted the offense efficiently last year and should be expected to do so again, albeit in a tough matchup this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: David Njoku (shoulder) is questionable for Week 12 against the Patriots.
items.text: Njoku’s potential absence would allow Charlie Kolar, and theoretically Oronde Gadsden, to play more, but neither tight end qualifies as a top-12 option in that scenario. Justin Herbert (concussion) is also out. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Chargers ruled out Keaton Mitchell (knee) in Week 12 against the Patriots.
items.text: Losing Mitchell helpfully condenses the Chargers’ backfield for fantasy purposes, though the offense will suffer with Justin Herbert (concussion) sidelined. Omarion Hampton is a volume-based RB2. Kimani Vidal is an RB3/4. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Chargers ruled out Justin Herbert (concussion) for Week 12 against the Patriots.
items.text: Chargers backup QB DJ Uiagalelei is expected to start in Herbert’s stead. He threw a touchdown pass when Herbert left early due to a hand injury a few weeks back, but he is tough to rely on as anything more than a volatile QB2. Hopefully, Herbert can return for Week 13 against the Buccaneers. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) is not on the Seahawks’ final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the 49ers.
items.text: The Seahawks have managed Smith-Njigba’s reps in practice all year, and this week was no different. He was limited on Wednesday and Thursday, but should be fine for Sunday. Smith-Njigba is an elite WR1, as always, and gets Sam Darnold (quad) back this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Sam Darnold (quad) is not on the Seahawks’ final injury report and will play in Week 12 against the 49ers.
items.text: The Seahawks’ starting quarterback will make his return for a divisional showdown against the 49ers. Darnold has been fairly banged up this year, but hopefully the time off was good for him. He is a QB2 in Week 12. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (Achilles) will not play in Las Vegas’ Week 12 game against the Browns.
items.text: The instant rule-out and talk of a potentially serious injury has us believing Powers-Johnson will hit IR ahead of Sunday Night Football. Caleb Rogers and Trey Zuhn have played in Powers-Johnson’s absence this year and one of them will likely start against the Browns. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Raheim Sanders (hip) is questionable for Cleveland’s Week 12 game against the Raiders.
items.text: Todd Monken said he’s “hoping” to activate Sanders, who has only gotten in limited practices this week. He sounds truly questionable for Sunday Night Football. If active, Sanders will cut into Dylan Sampson’s backup workload a bit. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Browns signed LS Rex Sunahara to a four-year contract extension.
items.text: Sunahara, 30 years young, has been the Browns’ snapper of balls that go longer than the league average since 2024. He’s now inked through his age-34 season. - Rivers McCown
